from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography; may be empty if no internal citations exist")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper; may be empty if this paper is not cited by any provided paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
